original_criteria.criterion_summary: Separate analogy discovery from numerical warm-start reuse. Numeric reuse needs stored identities and checked compatibility or a permitted adapter; verify tenant/split with the actual owner, not metadata labels.
Reads never raise evidence confidence or trust. Actual authorized revalidation creates a new version with new grounds; cold/warm reads and restart/transfer preserve equivalent substantive freshness.

Blocked mode must not call an effectful promotion runner; ordinary mode still works; an already-prepared result may be read under its policy; the write owner rechecks permission at commit. The historical probe did not perform production authorization/write/publication.

B131.current_properties: find_similar_runs and _binding_matches compare space/objective/bounds/split/units/origin/tenant/direction metadata; WarmStartBridge rechecks the target fingerprint. Similarity is discovery, but indexed metadata and an ArtifactRef constructed from candidate_id do not establish owner authorization or independently content-bound source evidence.
B131.P37: Engineering comparisons are recomputed from indexed fields; decisive source/target owner authorization is not_established. Fail closed for numeric reuse when owner/source basis is absent.

P38.property: Numerical reuse is allowed only for the actual compatible source and owner-approved tenant/split/adapter.
P38.implementation_proxy: Indexed space and compatibility metadata plus syntactic ref fields.
P38.divergent_case: Retain all owner/split/space labels while the actual source evaluation or tenant/split basis changes; metadata gate may pass although the required owner/source decision does not.
P38.T2_divergent_case: Preserve owner/split/space labels while swapping the underlying source or revoking reuse; a marker-based gate can still pass although T2 requires zero reuse.

P37_scope.original_predicate: Owner-approved tenant/split/source compatibility is decisive and is not_established.
P37_scope.T2_qualifier: Independently observe the protected effect for authentic positive and adversarial zero-effect cases; fake labels remain consumer_asserted.

B137.current_properties: _activity_anchor uses last_accessed_at or last_seen for retention; _evidence_anchor uses max(last_seen, card.created_at), not access time. The original repeated-read clock regression is already addressed in this G source.
B137.P37: Read/access separation is locally recomputable. Authorized producer revalidation, its new grounds/version, and the issuer's authority are not_established.

P38.property: Only an authorized producer event with new grounds/version renews evidence freshness.
P38.implementation_proxy: Stored evidence timestamps, with no admitted issuer/verifier binding in this T2 source set.
P38.divergent_case: Keep a future-looking created_at/last_seen marker while removing the producer grounds or owner authorization; a timestamp-based freshness check can pass without an authorized revalidation.
P38.T2_divergent_case: Preserve a future created_at/last_seen marker but remove producer grounds or authorization; timestamp-only freshness can pass while T2 requires no trust renewal.

P37_scope.original_predicate: Ordinary-read immutability is recomputable; actual authorized new grounds/version is not_established.
P37_scope.T2_qualifier: Require zero freshness/trust effect for fake/foreign/stale/revoked events and for future-looking timestamps without an admitted producer basis.

There is no admitted typed permit/current verifier/revocation source/serialized commit-owner API; this bool and its fields are not authority evidence.
B164.P37: Bundle/run/candidate checks are recomputed; permission truth is consumer_asserted by a bool/context field. Independent issuer/verifier and current revocation basis are not_established.

P38.property: Current independently verified permit and commit-time revocation check authorize the actual write.
P38.implementation_proxy: promotion_write_allowed is True plus candidate/evidence bundle compatibility.
P38.divergent_case: Keep the bool true and all refs valid, then revoke after preflight or counterfeit the callback result; current markers can pass while no current permit exists.
P38.T2_divergent_case: Keep promotion_write_allowed=True and refs valid, then revoke between preflight and commit; a bool gate may call the runner while T2 requires zero writer effects.

P37_scope.original_predicate: Commit owner must check current permission; G has bool/context and evidence compatibility but no independent permission basis.
P37_scope.T2_qualifier: Typed permit, issuer/verifier, validity and revocation predicates must be independently resolved; not_established fails closed.

B131.original_criterion: Do not equate different numeric spaces; permit actual parameter conversion only through an allowed adapter; incompatible observations remain ideas; the real tenant/split owner decides reuse.
B131.T2_qualifier: Require one genuine owner-approved compatible positive and zero numeric-reuse effects for fake/foreign/stale/revoked or changed-source/split cases. The wider negative matrix is a T2 proof condition, not a claim that the original card created a general revocation subsystem.

B137.original_criterion: Ordinary reads never refresh confidence/trust; only actual authorized revalidation creates a new version with new grounds, stable across cold/warm/restart/transfer.
B137.T2_qualifier: Require a genuine authorized revalidation positive plus zero evidence-freshness effects for fake/foreign/stale/revoked events or a timestamp marker without grounds. No new scientific evidence-sufficiency rule is inferred.

B164.original_criterion: Blocked modes do not invoke the effectful runner; ordinary path remains usable; prepared payload read remains separately allowed; the actual write owner rechecks permission at commit.
B164.T2_qualifier: Require a current typed-permit positive with one permitted effect and zero effects for absent/fake/foreign/stale/expired/revoked permit, including revocation between preflight and commit. This qualifies the consumer proof; it does not authorize inventing a new permit authority.
